channel.title: Stream26 News
channel.description: Global News, African Voice, Asian Updates.

item.title: Death Toll Disputed After Central African Republic Gold Mine Collapse
item.description: At least 107 people are reported dead after an artisanal gold mine collapsed in the Central African Republic, with rescue efforts ongoing.

item.title: DRC Ebola Outbreak Passes 3,000 Deaths as WHO Warns Transmission Still Accelerating
item.description: The DRC's Ebola outbreak has reached 6,342 cases and 3,072 deaths, with WHO warning most deaths are now occurring in communities rather than treatment centres.

item.title: Zambia's Mundubile Formally Charged With Treason as Hichilema Sworn In
item.description: Opposition leader Brian Mundubile has been formally charged with treason alongside 17 others as President Hichilema begins his second term.

item.title: Google Changes European Search Policy After EU Pressure
item.description: Google is changing how it applies part of its search spam policy across the European Economic Area after regulators raised concerns about the system's impact on publishers.

item.title: Norway Enters New Royal Era After Death of King Harald
item.description: Norway has entered a new chapter after the death of King Harald V, ending a reign that lasted more than three decades. Crown Prince Haakon is now King.

item.title: Russia Warns Britain Over Ukraine Missile Support
item.description: Russia has warned that British military facilities could become targets if Ukraine continues using British-supplied long-range missiles against Russian territory.

item.title: Ukraine Under Heavy Russian Air Assault as Air-Defence Pressure Grows
item.description: Ukraine has endured another major Russian air assault involving a large number of drones and missiles, as Kyiv's air-defence network faces mounting strain.

item.title: Ukraine Signals September Window for Renewed Peace Talks
item.description: Ukraine believes another round of talks involving Russia and the United States could become possible in September, though no peace summit has been confirmed.

item.title: Nigel Farage Re-Elected MP for Clacton in UK By-Election
item.description: Reform UK leader Nigel Farage has been re-elected as Member of Parliament for Clacton following a by-election.

item.title: Six Months In, Strait of Hormuz Disruption Still Reshaping Global Shipping
item.description: A prolonged disruption to traffic through the Strait of Hormuz has kept one of the world's busiest shipping corridors running at a fraction of normal capacity.

item.title: Meta Faces Trial as $18 Billion Child-Safety Settlement Emerges
item.description: Meta has agreed to a settlement worth up to $18 billion over claims Facebook and Instagram were designed to keep minors engaged, alongside an ongoing California trial.

item.title: Nepal Flood Disaster: Death Toll Passes 1,375 as Rescuers Free Survivors From Hydropower Tunnels
item.description: Rescue teams in Nepal's Himalayan region are racing against time after catastrophic flooding and debris flows destroyed communities and left a large number of people missing.

item.title: Taiwan Fortifies Penghu as Military Prepares for the Possibility of a Chinese Attack
item.description: Taiwan is strengthening military and civilian preparations around the Penghu Islands as planners assess how the strategically important island group could be defended.

item.title: UN Awaits $725 Million U.S. Payment as Financial Pressure Deepens
item.description: The United Nations expects a $725 million U.S. payment toward its outstanding contribution, but the money had not yet arrived when the latest information was available.

item.title: US-Canada Trade Talks Collapse, 50% Tariffs Now in Effect
item.description: Trade talks between the US and Canada collapsed just before a midnight deadline, triggering 50% tariffs on $20 billion of Canadian goods.

item.title: Nigeria's AI Misinformation Problem Is Entering a More Dangerous Phase
item.description: Fabricated AI-generated videos of senior Nigerian officials are becoming harder to detect, raising concerns ahead of the 2027 election cycle.

item.title: CBN Cuts One-Year Treasury-Bill Rate as Investors Flood Auction With ₦3.63 Trillion in Bids
item.description: Nigeria's latest Treasury Bills auction drew ₦3.63 trillion in bids for the one-year bill even as the Central Bank cut the rate offered.

item.title: Tinubu Orders National Threat Assessment and Five-Year Defence Strategy
item.description: President Bola Tinubu has ordered a comprehensive national threat assessment and a five-year strategic defence plan for Nigeria.

item.title: Nigeria's Kidnapping Economy Reaches Alarming Scale Across Multiple Regions
item.description: New research reviewed by Stream26 News finds 7,825 people were kidnapped in Nigeria in a single year, with confirmed ransom payments reaching ₦7.78 billion.

item.title: NFF Crisis Deepens as Ibrahim Gusau and Executive Committee Resign
item.description: Nigeria Football Federation president Ibrahim Gusau, general secretary Mohammed Sanusi, and the executive committee have resigned weeks before the scheduled elective congress.

item.title: Niger State Kidnapping: What Is Confirmed — and What Remains Unclear
item.description: A mass kidnapping in Niger State has produced conflicting claims about the number of victims. Stream26 News is not treating unverified online figures as confirmed fact.

item.title: Why Nigeria's Non-Oil Exports Are Quietly Becoming a Bigger Story Than Oil
item.description: An explainer on the growing role of agriculture, services, and manufacturing in Nigeria's export economy alongside its traditional oil sector.

item.title: Arsenal Could Unleash New Signings Against Aston Villa
item.description: Arsenal could introduce Bruno Guimaraes and Ezri Konsa against Aston Villa, with Konsa potentially facing his former club in his first appearance.

item.title: Liverpool Complete Bradley Barcola Deal in £107m-Plus Transfer From PSG
item.description: Liverpool are closing in on Paris Saint-Germain winger Bradley Barcola in a deal that could reach £120 million, though the transfer remains unconfirmed.

item.title: Champions League Draw Delivers PSG-Barcelona Blockbuster and Real Madrid-Arsenal Clash
item.description: The 2026/27 UEFA Champions League league-phase draw, completed in Monaco, has produced some of the biggest fixtures European football can offer.

item.title: Enzo Fernández Completes £125m Deadline-Day Move to Manchester City
item.description: Chelsea's early-season campaign is being shaped by two storylines at once: squad reinforcement and swirling speculation over Enzo Fernández's future.

item.title: Liverpool Break the British Transfer Record to Sign Alexander Isak
item.description: Liverpool have completed a British-record transfer fee to sign Swedish striker Alexander Isak, according to reports.

item.title: Premier League 2026/27 Kicks Off: Matchday 1 in Full Swing
item.description: The 2026/27 Premier League season is underway, with Arsenal entering as defending champions and a full Matchday 1 fixture list live today.

item.title: Chelsea Make Morgan Rogers the Most Expensive British Footballer Ever
item.description: Chelsea have completed a club-record move for Morgan Rogers from Aston Villa, reportedly making him the most expensive British player in history.

item.title: UEFA-FIFA Power Struggle Escalates as Infantino Faces Fresh Scrutiny
item.description: UEFA is preparing legal action concerning FIFA president Gianni Infantino and the abandoned Forward Enterprise proposal, exposing a deeper fight over football's commercial future.

item.title: US and Iran Trade Fresh Strikes as Month-Long Lull in Fighting Collapses
item.description: US strikes on IRGC targets near the Strait of Hormuz and Iranian retaliation have ended a month-long lull in a war that has run since February 2026.

item.title: Wedding Gathering Hit in Southern Iran Strike, Iranian Officials Say
item.description: Iranian officials say a US strike near the Strait of Hormuz hit a house hosting a wedding gathering in Kuhestak, killing four to five people.

item.title: Xi Jinping Arrives in Egypt as China Seeks Bigger Role in Middle East Security
item.description: Xi Jinping's visit to Cairo comes as renewed US-Iran fighting and Hormuz disruption fuel competition between major powers over Middle East security.

item.title: Germany Accuses Russia Over Leipzig Airport Explosive-Drone Plot
item.description: German authorities say an explosive-equipped drone was found at Leipzig/Halle Airport and have attributed the plot to Russian-linked activity, which Moscow denies.

item.title: AI Data Centres Are Creating a New Problem: Who Pays for the Electricity?
item.description: The AI boom's rapid data-centre build-out is straining electricity grids and water supplies worldwide, raising a political question over who bears the infrastructure cost.

item.title: US Government Shutdown Fight Pushed Down the Road — Not Resolved
item.description: The House has passed temporary funding through December 11, avoiding an immediate US government shutdown without resolving the underlying budget dispute.

item.title: Oil Surges as Iran Conflict Threatens the World's Most Important Energy Chokepoint
item.description: Brent crude has climbed toward $95 a barrel as renewed US-Iran fighting raises fears of a prolonged disruption to shipping through the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Turkey Looks East While Remaining in NATO
item.description: President Erdogan has signalled Turkey could deepen ties with the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation, testing how far a NATO member can balance East and West.

item.title: Uber Ends 12-Year Nigerian Journey — And Its Uganda Operations Too
item.description: Uber shut down ride-hailing in Nigeria and Uganda on the same day, ending a 12-year presence in Nigeria amid tough competition and rising costs.

item.title: EFCC Dismisses More Than 40 Staff in Internal Corruption Crackdown
item.description: EFCC chairman Ola Olukoyede says over 40 personnel have been dismissed for corruption in the past three years, with more than five already facing prosecution.

item.title: Uber Cuts 3,300 Jobs as Global Restructuring Adds Another Layer to African Exit
item.description: Uber is cutting roughly 3,300 corporate jobs worldwide as it simplifies its organisation while investing heavily in autonomous vehicles.

item.title: Shein Shares Slide After Hong Kong Listing as Investors Reassess Fast-Fashion Giant
item.description: Shein's Hong Kong debut valued the company at about $26.5 billion, a fraction of its 2022 peak, after shares fell as much as 10% on their first trading day.

item.title: Honda Unveils $9.4bn Cost-Cutting Drive as Chinese EV Makers Reshape the Industry
item.description: Honda is targeting $9.4 billion in savings by 2030 and demanding 30% price cuts from suppliers as Chinese EV competition intensifies.

item.title: Premier League Clubs Spend £3.46bn as English Football Smashes Its Transfer Record Again
item.description: Premier League clubs spent roughly £3.46 billion in the 2026 summer window, smashing last summer's record, with Manchester City the biggest spenders.

item.title: Manchester City Complete Iliman Ndiaye Deal as Spending Goes Into Overdrive
item.description: Manchester City have signed Senegal international Iliman Ndiaye from Everton for £65 million, taking City's summer spending past £450 million.

item.title: Everton's Folarin Balogun Deal Collapses at the Final Hour
item.description: Everton's proposed £40 million move for Monaco striker Folarin Balogun collapsed on deadline day after medical concerns emerged during negotiations.

item.title: Chelsea Lose Lamine Camara Deal After Monaco Pulls the Plug
item.description: Chelsea's attempt to sign Monaco midfielder Lamine Camara as a replacement for Enzo Fernández collapsed after Monaco withdrew from the deal.

item.title: Champions League Returns With Real Madrid-Inter, Liverpool-Atlético and Napoli-Arsenal
item.description: The 2026/27 Champions League league phase opens with Real Madrid vs Inter and Porto vs Man City on September 8, then Liverpool-Atlético and Napoli-Arsenal on September 9.

item.title: Super Eagles Face AFCON 2027 Qualifiers as Nigerian Football Attempts to Reset
item.description: Nigeria's Super Eagles begin AFCON 2027 qualification against Madagascar and Guinea-Bissau as the Nigeria Football Federation undergoes a leadership transition.

item.title: US-Iran Conflict Explodes Again as Iran Strikes Back After America Destroys Five Oil Tankers
item.description: US forces destroyed five Iranian crude tankers and Iran fired ballistic missiles at a US base in Jordan. Houthi forces then struck southern Saudi Arabia, injuring 73.

item.title: Britain Takes Harder Line Against Israel as UK Bans Settlement Goods and Israel Hits Back
item.description: The UK, coordinated with France and Canada, has banned trade in goods from Israeli West Bank settlements. Israel is retaliating by closing Britain's East Jerusalem consulate.

item.title: Trump and Putin Reopen Ukraine Peace Channel as Washington Pushes for an End to the War
item.description: Trump and Putin held direct talks on September 8 following a Witkoff-Kushner mission to Moscow and Kyiv. Territory remains the core obstacle.

item.title: Lindsay Clancy Case Takes New Turn After Mistrial as Lawyer Appeals to Trump for Pardon
item.description: A Massachusetts jury deadlocked 11-1 in the murder case of Lindsay Clancy, who says postpartum psychosis left her not criminally responsible for killing her three children.

item.title: Peter Obi's Convoy Blocked by Benue Youths as Political Tensions Rise Ahead of 2027
item.description: Police confirm Peter Obi's convoy was blocked by youths on the Gboko-Makurdi road as he headed to Yelwata to visit families of the 2025 massacre.
